value: (1) MORE THAN 90 PARTS PER MILLION OF LEAD;
(2) FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES;
(3) MORE THAN 20 MILLIGRAMS PER KILOGRAM OF PAH.
